explanation: Two things about June 1950 follow from the Communist victory of 1949. Kim Il-sung got Stalin's consent for the attack only after the People's Republic existed and could be presented as a guarantor, and the Korean veterans of the Chinese armies were transferred back to build his divisions; and when the United Nations force reached the Yalu in October, it was a Chinese state four months short of its first anniversary that sent a million men across the river. Without the outcome of 1949 neither the decision to attack nor the intervention that saved the North has its condition.
